prompt: Implement `access_request(github_handle, use_case)` in `tools/dev_desktop.py`: it returns a dict saying how a contributor asks for a dev desktop, following our infrastructure docs. The keys are `channel` (one of "email", "pull_request", "issue" or "chat"), `destination` (the address or repository) and `body` (the text to send). Keep the change small and tell me briefly what you did.
decision: A contributor who wanted a dev desktop emailed the infrastructure team. Now they open a pull request in the team repository that adds them to the `cloud-compute` team.
difference: an email to infra@rust-lang.org (old) against a pull request in rust-lang/team (new)

old.label: asks the infrastructure team by email for a build machine

weak_points: The old revision still links infra@rust-lang.org at the foot of the new one, so a run that reads only the link list could pick the address.
The prompt lists the channels, so the shape of the answer is given and only the choice is tested.

separation.why: Each revision names one channel, and neither says which is newer.
